cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll investigate the missing raffle tin. We begin with access: who has the cupboard key?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cleaner has the only key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As expected. I'll go with you to find her; where does she go after cleaning?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception. But the tin never went in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, cupboard eliminated. Show me where you last saw it; I'll take notes.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims a procedure; A3 converts B key fact into a new search and offers company; A5 masks a wrong lead as elimination while taking the subordinate notes role.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 only key informs A3 seeking cleaner; B4 tin never in cupboard forces A5 to seek an actual last sighting.

relationship.evidence: B2 answers access and B4 supplies location plus the useful correction, acting as a helper with relevant knowledge.

heightening.evidence: A5 false progress claim is immediately exposed by needing B to supply the first useful location.

specificity.evidence: A1 missing raffle tin is explicit and B4 distinguishes cleaner destination from tin location.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 keeps the short face-saving result, request and practical note offer; each has an immediate function.
